outcome: The research-AI connector now has one exact current surface with no retired authoring inputs
owner_impact: Student and Professor research-AI sessions receive exactly 9 shared Virtual Lab tools. Experiment creation and whole-source editing accept only the canonical ordered artifacts array with Configuration, Initialization, Controller and Metrics supplied explicitly; the retired three-source connector form and implicit Metrics insertion are removed. Role differences remain authorization/visibility differences rather than duplicate tools.

next.text: Next is #336, fresh-chat scientific acceptance from the reset baseline using this exact connector surface.

technical_evidence: The exact tool set is read_workspace, manage_collection, create_experiment, edit_experiment, delete_experiment, author_metrics_results, request_capability, resume_capability_closure, and revalidate_capability_closure.
Health reports the exact tool-name array and derives all Student/Professor/shared counts from the same 9-name contract.
create_experiment requires artifacts[] with at least the four compulsory core artifacts; edit_experiment accepts only a complete canonical artifacts[] replacement for whole-source changes.
The MCP connector no longer exposes config_source, initializer_source or controller_source compatibility inputs and no longer contains the legacy merge/conversion branches.
MCP server 3.10.0, interface 14 and authoring contract vlab.authoring/0.8 version the breaking cutover explicitly; capability-request interface v6 is unchanged.
No GitHub, repository, shell, deployment, arbitrary filesystem, arbitrary SQL/admin, simulator-control or simulator-development tool is added.
